text: The grass is currently wearing a tuxedo made of static electricity because it is afraid of the sky. Your goldfish is not swimming in circles; she is actually trying to untangle the concept of Tuesday from the fabric of space-time. The glass bowl is not a barrier, but a very polite invitation to the universe to come in and have tea. She has already discovered a new planet, which is just a giant, floating spoon that tastes like the color purple. Do not worry about the interstellar ambitions; the spoon is very shy and prefers to stay in the bowl until the moon learns how to knit.
